将在浏览器中安全登录，完成后自动返回。登录后可访问获授权项目或通过邀请加入。: Sign in securely in your browser and return automatically. You can then access authorized projects or join with an invitation.
开放注册时，你在注册页提交的用户名、邮箱、显示名称及密码会经 Brigitte: When registration is open, the username, email, display name, and password you submit are sent through Brigitte to Heimdall to create an account; Brigitte does not store your registration password. Registration does not verify your email. Tenant administrators create online projects, and members join through a valid invitation or administrator assignment.
租户管理员可管理所有项目和成员；项目负责人可管理所负责的项目，生成带可选密码的邀: Tenant administrators can manage all projects and members. Project owners can manage their own projects, create invitation links with optional passwords, and remove members. The random invitation credential is shown only when created; the server stores its digest and an optional password hash. Projects, bugs, replies, work records, and attachments you submit are sent to Brigitte and shared according to project permissions.
